subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, should expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and how should OpenClaw handle missing referenced values?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but it changes credential propagation and whether lower-trust workspace files can influence provider, auth, runtime, or service environment values.

options.title: Approve scoped expansion
options.body: Expand references only after workspace blocklists and trusted-source precedence are applied, with explicit missing-reference behavior and regression coverage for provider/auth variables.

options.title: Keep dotenv values literal
options.body: Document `.env` values as literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRefs, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Defer to broader secret UX
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the related SecretRef/env-source design before changing dotenv semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped expansion
recommendation.body: Expand references only after workspace blocklists and trusted-source precedence are applied, with explicit missing-reference behavior and regression coverage for provider/auth variables.
